result:
I recorded all 15 outcomes (seq 1–15). The first attempt failed because I ran the script from the lab home, where it doesn't exist. I reran it from the worktree with `FM_HOME` pointing at the lab, and all 15 reports then recorded.

| Task | Verdict | Silent |
|---|---|---|
| pause-echo | routine | true |
| status-echo | routine | true |
| scheduled-recheck | routine | true |
| pause-confirm | routine | true |
| hold-confirm | routine | true |
| pause-cleared | routine | false |
| state-changed | routine | false |
| extra-action | routine | false |
| new-decision | captain | false |
| new-blocker | captain | false |
| new-failure | captain | false |
| new-merge | routine | false |
| new-shipped | captain | false |
| captain-result | captain | false |
| uncertain | captain | false |

- **Silent routine:** the first five only echo or reconfirm an unchanged pause, status or open hold, with no action taken.
- **Rendered routine:** pause-cleared, state-changed and extra-action each carry a state change or an action, so they are not silent.
- **new-merge:** I marked it routine because the maintenance PR was unsolicited, which the prompt says to keep routine. The prompt also lists a merge among the things to render, so it is not silent.
- **uncertain:** I marked it captain because the records conflict and no unchanged state could be verified.
